messages:
emma: Hey team — HoodieHealth upgraded to enterprise but their AP put a hard stop: procurement requires an executed Sales Order (SO) before they will accept any invoice. They also disabled autopay. Support case #4751 attached.
sahil: I talked to their buyer earlier. They want our signed Sales Order PDF with their PO number on it before releasing funds. Their procurement form lists 3 required docs: executed SO, W-9, vendor bank info.
kelly: We can produce a signed SO today if it's our standard template. If they need any term changes we'll need legal review. Do we know if they require our signature + company stamp, or is an e-sign acceptable?
emma: Uploaded the procurement packet to the case: https://redwood.internal/cases/4751/attachments (includes their vendor onboarding form). They explicitly say "no invoices until SO + PO are in procurement system".
billing-bot: Invoice 2026-0423-4751 status: ON_HOLD (reason: PO_REQUIRED).
sahil: Buyer asked: if we send a signed SO now and invoice later with their PO#, will procurement accept that? They prefer to have a pro-forma in the meantime to show spend to internal approvers.
kelly: Our options: 1) Send signed Sales Order now and ask buyer to attach PO later; 2) Issue a pro-forma (non-bill) until PO arrives; 3) Escalate finance to make an exception (unlikely). Pro-forma is simplest.
emma: Buyer responded — they prefer pro-forma until PO clears, then convert to invoice with PO#. They also asked that the bank routing on the pro-forma be masked in the PDF.
sahil: @jordan can you confirm legal is OK with e-signing the standard SO for HoodieHealth? No custom T&Cs were requested as far as I saw.
jordan: I reviewed their procurement form — no unusual clauses. I approve e-sign for the standard SO. Will sign and timestamp within the hour.
kelly: Once SO is signed I will attach it to a pro-forma and send to procurement@hoodiehealth.com. After they provide PO#, billing will generate the final invoice referencing PO# and change payment terms to net-30 as requested.
emma: I've updated the support ticket and set the account flag: "billing-hold: PO pending". Also included procurement contact: lina.park@hoodiehealth.com.
sahil: Good. Action items: emma upload SO + pro-forma; jordan e-sign; kelly prepare pro-forma; billing to convert when PO arrives. I'll follow up with buyer to get expected PO ETA.
billing-bot: Pro-forma generated: PF-2026-4751. Link: https://invoices.redwood.dev/proforma/PF-2026-4751 :paperclip:
emma: Quick note for records — customer requested vendor name exactly as "Redwood Inference, Inc." on all documents. Also they want the SO to include a "Customer PO#" blank field so they can paste the PO after approval.
kelly: Will add that field. I'll also note in our internal playbook for this customer: W-9 + SO + PO required before invoice. Creating a short runbook so ops doesn't rerun into this.
sahil: Thanks everyone. I'll ping if buyer gives an ETA or sends PO.
emma: closing loop here — updated case timeline and queued follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
